## Architecture Overview

**Pattern:** {MVVM / MVC / Clean Architecture / Hexagonal / CQRS / Layered / …}

**Layer responsibilities:**

| Layer | Responsibility | Location |
|-------|---------------|----------|
| {e.g. Presentation / UI} | {e.g. Render state, handle user events, no business logic} | `{src/ui/ or app/src/main/java/.../ui/}` |
| {e.g. Domain / Use Cases} | {e.g. Business rules, pure functions, no framework deps} | `{src/domain/}` |
| {e.g. Data / Repository} | {e.g. Data access, mapping, caching, network calls} | `{src/data/}` |

**Data flow direction:** {e.g. UI → ViewModel → UseCase → Repository → DataSource → (back up)}

## Folder & File Conventions

```
{project_root}/
├── {src or app}/
│   ├���─ {feature_1}/          # Feature-based module: contains UI, VM, domain, data
│   │   ├── {Screen}.{ext}    # UI component
│   │   ├── {Feature}ViewModel.{ext}
│   │   ├── {Feature}Repository.{ext}
│   │   └── {Feature}UseCase.{ext}    # if Clean Architecture
│   ├── core/                 # Shared utilities, base classes, extensions
│   ├── data/                 # Global data sources, DTOs, mappers
│   └── di/                   # Dependency injection wiring
├── tests/ or src/test/       # Unit tests mirror src structure
└── {build_config_file}       # e.g. build.gradle.kts / package.json / pyproject.toml
```

## Naming Conventions

| Element | Convention | Example |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| Class / Component | {e.g. PascalCase} | `{UserProfileScreen}` |
| File | {e.g. PascalCase.kt / kebab-case.tsx / snake_case.py} | `{UserProfileScreen.kt}` |
| Function / Method | {e.g. camelCase / snake_case} | `{loadUserProfile()}` |
| Variable | {e.g. camelCase / snake_case} | `{userProfile}` |
| Constant | {e.g. SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE / UPPER_SNAKE} | `{MAX_RETRY_COUNT}` |
| Interface / Protocol | {e.g. Noun or I-prefix} | `{UserRepository / IUserRepository}` |
| Test function | {e.g. `fun \`description of scenario\`()`} | `{fun \`returns null when user not found\`()}` |
| ViewModel | {e.g. FeatureViewModel suffix} | `{UserProfileViewModel}` |
| Repository | {e.g. FeatureRepository suffix} | `{UserRepository}` |

## Testing Conventions

**Unit tests:** {e.g. JUnit5 + MockK / Jest / pytest} — test business logic and ViewModels  
**Integration tests:** {e.g. Room in-memory DB tests / Supertest / TestClient}  
**UI/E2E tests:** {e.g. Compose UI tests / Playwright / Detox / XCUITest}

**Rules:**
- {e.g. Test files live at `src/test/` mirroring `src/main/` structure}
- {e.g. Test function names describe the scenario: `fun \`returns error when network fails\`()`}
- {e.g. Use `@TestCoroutineDispatcher` / `runTest` for coroutine tests}
- {e.g. Mock only at the boundary (repository interfaces); never mock domain logic}
- {e.g. Minimum 80% coverage for ViewModel and UseCase classes}

## Agent Bug-Fix Rules

These rules apply specifically when the bug-fixing agent is working on this project:

1. **Scope creep is forbidden** — only modify files listed in the bug ticket's `affectedFiles`.
2. **Follow existing code style exactly** — match indentation, naming, and import ordering.
3. **Do not refactor** — do not rename, extract, or reorganise code outside the fix scope.
4. **Cite standards** — every fix must cite which knowledge file(s) guided the decision.
5. **Impact analysis is mandatory** — always list direct and indirect impacts before concluding.
6. **Regression checks are mandatory** — always provide manual test steps covering the fix and adjacent behaviours.
